confidence_notes: Current Nha Trang aggregate prices support the meal, cappuccino, and draft-beer anchors. Cocktail pricing uses local bar-price ranges; the wine-glass estimate uses its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and are less certain.
